value.rationale: Proper three-colorings of an infinite path form a canonical positive-entropy nearest-neighbor shift with a natural cyclic color action. The result gives a complete nontrivial centralizer classification: there are precisely six nonlinear possibilities, all necessarily traffic lifts and all nonsurjective, while strengthening color symmetry collapses them and all color twists to exactly three shifts. This is a structural rigidity phenomenon and exact classification, not an arbitrary slice or isolated code count.
